subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result classes may be hidden from the model-visible prompt to protect prefix-cache reuse without breaking agent reasoning?
rationale: The code can preserve provider pairing mechanically, but deciding that a tool's result is safe to hide changes agent semantics and needs owner intent before automation rewrites this PR.

options.title: Narrow Ephemeral Policy
options.body: Allow placeholders only for maintainer-approved non-informational heartbeat/status outputs and keep ordinary information-gathering tool results visible.

options.title: Design A Broader Cache Policy
options.body: Pause this PR and solve the linked issue through a richer cache/result lifecycle that can summarize, isolate, or prune outputs by tool contract.

options.title: Reject Provider-Level Hiding
options.body: Leave provider conversion faithful and rely on heartbeat isolation, pruning, or session-level fixes instead.

recommendation.title: Narrow Ephemeral Policy
recommendation.body: Allow placeholders only for maintainer-approved non-informational heartbeat/status outputs and keep ordinary information-gathering tool results visible.

likelyOwner.reason: The current provider conversion files and prompt-cache adjacent history point most strongly to this owner for the policy choice.
